purpose: Provide an executable fixture-local prepared aerodynamic coefficient table, trilinear pure query, strict applicability domain and dimensionalization consumer link.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted the recommended fixture-local trilinear, inclusive-domain, no-extrapolation choice. The numeric table is synthetic and multi-affine, used only to verify lookup semantics and the existing dimensionalization consumer.

expected_facts.claim: Independent 80-digit Decimal and C++17 implementations locate three strict-axis brackets and reproduce the six multi-affine coefficients with an eight-corner tensor product.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Model/table/configuration/sample identities and bracket indices are exact; weights and coefficients use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Interior, knot and upper-boundary responses feed the accepted body-axis aerodynamic dimensionalization with the existing coefficient order and reference-length policy.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Coefficient convention and domain status are exact; force and moment values use the fixture-local formula tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Interpolation nesting order is physically equivalent, while invalid query/asset identity, unsupported inputs, axis/table defects, out-of-range values, nearest-neighbor substitution, clamping, axis swap and omitted beta interpolation fail directly.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Failure and equivalence identities are exact; tolerance cannot admit an invalid table or out-of-domain query.

acceptance: The bundle fixes strict prepared axes, trilinear interpolation, inclusive applicability, no extrapolation and the existing coefficient convention
The Decimal reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Canonical assets, loaders, nonzero rates/surfaces, derivative queries and product contracts remain outside this slice
